messages.author: b5566b68e05707a0
messages.subject: change frequency max
parts:
Dear all,
I tried to change the min / max of the frequency axis instead of 0 - 20kHz (for f=44100), for example when plotting a spectrogram
using spectro, but I didn't find the way to do that. I know that if I change the sampling frequency,
it will change the max, but I do not want to resampling my sound. Maybe I missed something.
Thanks
Best
Olivier

messages.author: bfa183f4897a5619
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] change frequency max
parts:
Hi Olivier,

You can use the flim argument to spectro() for this; there are a couple of examples in the spectro() help page.

Best,
Jesse Ross

Thanks,

# vertical zoom using flim
spectro(tico,f=22050, ylim=c(2,6))
spectro(tico,f=22050, ylimd=c(2,6))

maybe:

# vertical zoom using flim
spectro(tico,f=22050, flim=c(2,6))
spectro(tico,f=22050, flimd=c(2,6))

?
